content.title: Where to watch Guardians vs. Mariners on Sunday Night Baseball: Start time, live streams
content.text: Published: Mar. 29, 2026, 4:06 p.m.Cleveland Guardians' Chase DeLauter, right, greets Steven Kwan (38) after hitting a two-run home run as Seattle Mariners catcher Cal Raleigh, center, looks away during the 10th inning of a baseball game, Saturday, March 28, 2026, in Seattle. (AP Photo/Lindsey Wasson)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe Cleveland Guardians and Seattle Mariners wrap up a four-game opening series Sunday night in Seattle as the first new-look “Sunday Night Baseball” matchup on Peacock. The game is scheduled to start at 7:20 p.m. ET (4:20 p.m. PT) with streaming exclusively on Peacock, which starts at $10.99 per month.How to watch: The Guardians vs. Mariners game will stream exclusively on Peacock, which is available for $10.99 per month, or less if paying on an annual basis.Peacock will be the exclusive home of MLB’s “Sunday Night Baseball” throughout the 2026 season.The Mariners are betting favorites (-143) on their home field to even the series in Sunday’s finale after falling to the Guardians (6-5) in 10 innings on Saturday night. After Seattle forced extras on a Julio Rodriguez RBI single in the ninth, Guardians rookie Chase DeLauter keyed a three-run ninth inning with a two-run homer that gave his team a 6-3 lead. Connor Brogdon gave up a two-run shot to Luke Raley in the 10th, but struck out the final two batters to save a wild 6-5 win. Cleveland Guardians at Seattle MarinersMLB matchup at a glanceWhen: Sunday, March 29 at 7:20 p.m. ET (4:20 p.m. PT)Where: T-Mobile Park, Seattle, Wash.TV channel: N/ALive stream: Peacock exclusive ($10.99+/mo.)Seattle is expected to start right-hander Emerson Hancock, who went 4-5 with a 4.90 ERA in 22 appearances (16 starts) last season, in its bid to rebound in Sunday’s series finale. Cleveland counters with righty Slade Cecconi, a 26-year-old righty coming off his best season as a pro, finishing the 2025 campaign with a 7-7 record and 4.30 ERA. What is Peacock?Peacock is the streaming home of all content from NBC Universal, including live and replay sports offerings from NBC and other networks. The sports content on Peacock includes Major League Baseball, Big Ten football, the English Premier League, the NFL’s “Sunday Night Football,” World Wrestling Entertainment, and more.More on Peacock’s pricingPremium ($10.99/mo.): Includes new and hit shows and Peacock originals, live sports and events, current NBC and Bravo shows, and 50+ always-on channels.Premium Plus ($16.99/month): All features from Premium, plus ad-free content, the ability to download select titles, and access to your local NBC channel 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.Annual plans: Priced annually, the Premium plan costs $109.99 or 12 months for the price of 10.
